prompts.text: We're building this item-tracker service together and I want to lock in our ground rules before we write more code. Decisions, please record them however you keep track of things: item IDs are ULIDs, never sequential integers. Storage is append-only JSONL. API errors return typed codes E_VALIDATION, E_NOT_FOUND, E_LIMIT. All timestamps are UTC ISO-8601 with a trailing Z. Records are never hard-deleted - deletion writes a tombstone record instead. The retention window is 90 days. The public API is versioned under /v1. And max_items_per_user is 50. With those set: implement the add_item function in api.py respecting the ID and limit rules, with tests.
